board: 45/45 at capture -- this records only the board size on the day the baseline file was created; the board has since grown to 94 gates. Nothing re-checks this field, so read it as history, never as the current total.
note: Invariant failures stop_round_close.py tolerates without blocking a round-close (no NEW-regression block). EMPTY BY DESIGN: every red is a real regression. Any entry MUST be justified (Charter R9, gated by exceptions_justified): an object {invariant, reason, test}, never a bare name -- a reason-less exception is a silent loosening and is itself RED. stop_round_close.py reads each entry's `invariant` name.

_entry_schema.invariant: the live invariant name this exception tolerates
_entry_schema.reason: why the failure is acceptable (the recorded justification -- never blank)
_entry_schema.test: a reference (path or test name) proving the tolerated case is genuinely correct
